reading: A reading: BigCommerce's Storefront Search and Search Filters settings ("Identifies and updates storefront search settings", BC-S-0067; "enabled filters, available filters, and contextual filters", BC-S-0066) and its plan line Product filtering (BC-S-0065) are the storefront's search and filters, Shopify's Search (SH-S-0867) and Salla's Product filter settings (SA-S-1756). Every statement of BC-C-011 is cited in CM-SFR-013.

A new capability, a reading: BigCommerce's Sites API group, "Create and manage sites and routes for headless storefront sales channels" (BC-S-0231), with its scope store_sites (BC-S-0232) and its webhook topic for a channel's site (BC-S-0233). No capability of the model holds a site or route of a channel: CM-SFR-011 is the headless storefront itself, CM-SFR-008 the store's domain name, and no statement of BC-C-040 speaks of a domain. Every statement of BC-C-040 is cited in CM-SFR-014.

A reading: BigCommerce's Redirects API group, to "Manage 301 redirects for one or more storefronts" (BC-S-0234), is Zid's URL redirects (إعادة توجيه الروابط, ZD-S-0967) and Shopify's URL redirects (urlRedirectBulkDeleteAll, SH-S-6245). Every statement of BC-C-041 is cited in CM-CNT-009.

A reading: BigCommerce's Themes API group, to "Backup, restore, download, and activate themes" (BC-S-0236), and its scope store_themes_manage (BC-S-0242) are the store's theme, Shopify's Themes and templates (SH-S-7003) and its THEMES permission (SH-I-1119). BC-C-042 is coarser than CM-SFR-001's children: its Stencil theme engine and custom templates (BC-S-0238, BC-S-0237) are cited in CM-SFR-002, and its design-theme licence terms (BC-S-0239, BC-S-0240, BC-S-0241) in CM-SFR-003, both children of CM-SFR-001, so the concern lands in the parent.

A join on role, a reading: BigCommerce's Widgets API group, to "Create and manage widget templates, widgets, regions, and placements" (BC-S-0244), and its page widgets, which divide pages "into regions, layouts, dropzones, and widgets" (BC-S-0245), add elements to the storefront's design besides the theme: the role of Shopify's App Store category Store design apps (SH-S-2662) and Salla's Component Bundle (SA-S-1165). BigCommerce builds them itself, where Shopify's and Salla's statements show apps and partners. Every statement of BC-C-043 is cited in CM-SFR-005.

A join on role, a reading: BigCommerce's Scripts API group, to "Add client-side code to a BigCommerce storefront page" (BC-S-0247), through which "the app can freely update its own scripts" (BC-S-0249), is how an installed app adds its code to the storefront: Shopify's script tags (write_script_tags, SH-S-6291) and Salla's App Snippet, "custom JavaScript" (SA-S-0209). Strained: CM-SFR-004 is the app's code in the storefront, and BigCommerce's Script Manager is also where the merchant installs and inspects scripts from the control panel (BC-S-0248, BC-S-0249), the merchant's own code, which no capability of the model holds apart. All four statements are cited in CM-SFR-004.

A reading: BigCommerce's Pages V3 ("A page appears on a site that is associated with a channel", BC-S-0251) and its page webhook (BC-S-0255) are the store's pages, Shopify's Page (SH-I-0166, SH-S-1030). The concern also holds the built-in blog, cited in CM-CNT-004, a child of CM-CNT-003, so it lands in the parent. Strained: its Content API statement, "Manage blog posts, blog tags, content pages, and redirects" (BC-S-0252), is also cited in CM-CNT-009 (URL redirects), which is not under CM-CNT-003.

A reading: BigCommerce's metafields, "custom metadata associated with store resources" (BC-S-0276), attached to the store itself or to other objects (BC-S-0277), are Shopify's Metafields (SH-S-0779). BigCommerce's statements hold no counterpart to Shopify's metaobjects: the capability's name holds both, and the cell claims metafields only. Every statement of BC-C-049 is cited in CM-CNT-002.

A reading: Catalyst, "BigCommerce's composable, fully customizable headless ecommerce storefront framework" (BC-S-0281), is a headless storefront, Shopify's Build headless storefronts (SH-S-7056), and a storefront framework in the role of Shopify's Hydrogen framework (SH-S-0831). Its statement that Catalyst implements the GraphQL Storefront API (BC-S-0283) is cited in CM-SFR-012, a child of CM-SFR-011.

A reading: Makeswift, "BigCommerce's visual page builder" (BC-S-0284), is a page builder, Shopify's App Store category Page builder apps (SH-I-1938). Strained: CM-SFR-006 sits under CM-SFR-005 and CM-SFR-001, the theme's storefront, while BigCommerce's statements put Makeswift with Catalyst, its headless framework (BC-S-0284, BC-S-0286), CM-SFR-011's tree. All three statements are cited in CM-SFR-006.

Moved to domain G, a reading: Native Hosting, "BigCommerce provides hosting for your Catalyst projects, allowing you to fully deploy your Catalyst storefront without having to depend on an external hosting provider" (BC-S-0288), with its Infrastructure Hosting API group (BC-S-0287), is the hosting of the store, G's CM-OPS-003 (Hosting of the store: the environment the store runs on), whose BigCommerce cell already cites BC-S-0288 and BC-S-0287 as core (BC-C-052 names G under also). One thing, one domain: no capability is added here. BC-S-0287's "add custom domains" is also cited in CM-SFR-008 (notes).

A reading: BigCommerce's Storefront API, to "Query products, customers, and carts from the storefront" (BC-S-0293), and its storefront API tokens (BC-S-0292) are Shopify's Storefront API (SH-S-0825). Every statement of BC-C-053 is cited in CM-SFR-012.

A reading: BigCommerce's plan line Free sitewide HTTPS and dedicated SSL, "All traffic to your site is over HTTPs and comes with a free dedicated SSL" (BC-S-0423), is Shopify's Free SSL certificate (SH-S-7034) and Salla's شهادة SSL مجانية (SA-S-2038). Strained: the concern is wider than the SSL certificate. Its Storefront Security settings (BC-S-0422, with webhook BC-S-0424) don't say what they set, and its Tier 1 certifications, "ISO, SOC, PCI, FIPS, RH-ISAC, GDPR, and CCPA" (BC-S-0421), bear on the platform's security and compliance as a whole, which no capability of any domain holds (caps: PCI;ISO;SOC;compliance;certifications;security). BC-S-0421 is recorded as a quality of CM-SFR-010; the reviewer may move it.

Joined by terms, a reading: BigCommerce's Channels API group, "Create and manage sales channels, their sites, and their product listings" (BC-S-0219), with its scope store_channel_settings (BC-S-0223) and its channel webhooks (BC-S-0225), is Shopify's Sales channels (SH-S-1496) and Salla's Sales channels (SA-S-1687). Strained: the concern's plan line Online storefront (BC-S-0221) is cited by batch 1 in CM-SFR-001, the theme's online store; BC-S-0219 is also cited in CM-SFR-014 (a channel's sites) and, with BC-S-0224, in CM-CHN-004 (a channel's product listings), which is not under CM-CHN-001. The concern is BigCommerce's whole channel object, wider than publishing to a channel.

A new capability, a reading: Multi-Storefront, "the ability to manage multiple unique Storefronts within one Store" (BC-S-0227), with its plan line Multi-storefront (BC-S-0228). No capability of any domain holds several storefronts in one store (caps --terms "multi-storefront; storefronts; multiple stores; expansion store; multi-store": CM-ACC-003 is several stores under one owner, CM-SFR-001 and CM-SFR-011 one storefront each). Every statement of BC-C-039 is cited in CM-CHN-007. Q1's responsible gap: stated only in general terms.

Joined on role, a reading: Feedonomics Surface "connects your store to ad channels and keeps product listings accurate as your catalog changes" (BC-S-0365), the role of Shopify's product feeds (product_feeds/create, SH-S-6093) and Salla's catalog feeds (google-merchant-feed, SA-S-3201): the store's products kept listed on another channel. Its maker: BigCommerce's list of contracting entities names Feedonomics Holdings, LLC for the Feedonomics Platform (BC-S-0366), the same reading batch 1 made of Makeswift, Inc. (BC-S-0285); no statement held says in words that it is of BigCommerce's group. Every statement of BC-C-067 is cited in CM-CHN-004. Q1's reason gap: searched, not found.

Joined by definition, a reading: "Connect your store to the world's largest marketplaces to reach millions of new shoppers while managing all your orders from BigCommerce" (BC-S-0369), with its product line Marketplaces, "Sell across Amazon, Walmart, eBay" (BC-S-0368), is Shopify's connecting the catalog to marketplaces and syncing their orders (SH-S-0727) and Zid's Marketplaces (ZD-S-0458). Strained: the concern also holds the product lines Social channels (BC-I-0521, cited in CM-CHN-001, the parent) and Google Shopping (BC-I-0522, cited in CM-CHN-004, which is not under CM-CHN-001); neither has a statement beyond its name. Q1's responsible gap is stated only in general terms, its reason gap searched, not found.

Joined by terms, a reading: BigCommerce's plan line Point of sale (BC-S-0372) and product line POS integrations (BC-S-0371) are Shopify's Point of Sale (SH-S-7017) and Salla's Salla Point (SA-S-1836). Strained: CM-POS-001 is in-person selling from the platform's own POS app, and BigCommerce's statements show only integrations to other companies' point-of-sale systems ("POS integrations to Square, Vend, Clover, Heartland Retail, and more", BC-S-0372); no statement held names a POS app of BigCommerce's (searched: Point of sale;POS;in-store;cashier). A proposal for the coordinator: rename CM-POS-001 "Point of sale: in-person selling, from the platform's own POS app or connected POS systems", or split connected POS systems out. All its statements are cited in CM-POS-001.

Joined by terms, a reading: BigCommerce's Store Translations scope (store_translations, BC-S-0274), its Translations Admin GraphQL API (BC-S-0270) and its locales per sales channel (BC-S-0272) are Shopify's translations and locales (read_translations, SH-S-6140; locales/create, SH-S-6020) and Salla's Languages (SA-S-1723). Every statement of BC-C-048 is cited in CM-MKS-008. Q1's responsible gap is stated only in general terms, its reason gap searched, not found.

Joined by terms, a reading: BigCommerce's Currencies (Settings > Setup > Currencies, BC-S-0399; the Currencies API, BC-S-0398) and its plan line Multi-currency (BC-S-0400) are Shopify's multi-currency selling (Show prices in local currencies, SH-S-7058) and Salla's Currencies (SA-S-1724). Its statements on conversion (BC-S-0405, BC-S-0406, BC-S-0409) are cited in CM-MKS-007, and its currency per country (BC-S-0402) in CM-MKS-004, both under CM-MKS-001 with CM-MKS-006. Strained: BC-S-0404, the only statement held on the store's default currency, is cited in CM-MKS-005, which is not under CM-MKS-001.

Joined by terms, a reading: BigCommerce's Geography API, "Get countries, states, and provinces ... for use in shipping, tax, and address validation workflows" (BC-S-0412), is Salla's Countries (SA-S-1048) and WooCommerce's data-countries (WC-S-0126). BC-S-0412 is its only statement, cited in CM-MKS-009. Q1's gaps: who sets the list of countries (decides) and its boundary are searched, not found.
